enchantments.tooltip: Alchemical Earth Attunement: Attacks and offensive spells deal stacking acid damage over time.
Bloody Thorns: This powerful item is a dangerous weapon to those well-versed in Nature. You receive a Primal bonus to Damage for every four of your Wilderness Lore feats.
Insightful Resistance +6: Passive: +6 Insight bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Insightful Doublestrike 8%: Passive: 8% Insight bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Insightful Doubleshot 5%: Passive: 5% Insight bonus to Doubleshot. (Doubleshot is a chance to score an additional hit with a ranged attack.)
